title.en: Thinking Machines opens Inkling 2 Small on Tinker, defers weights
title.zhHans: Thinking Machines 在 Tinker 开放 Inkling 2 Small，暂缓发布权重

searchSummary.en: Inkling 2 Small became available in Tinker Playground on November 5; downloadable full weights remained contingent on testing.
searchSummary.zhHans: Inkling 2 Small 于 11 月 5 日在 Tinker Playground 开放；完整权重下载仍待测试完成。

summary.en: Thinking Machines Lab announced Inkling 2 Small on November 5 and said users could try it in Tinker Playground and fine-tune or sample it on Tinker. It planned to release the full weights under Apache 2.0 the following week, after external safety testing and red-teaming. Checkpoints would be downloadable with that future weight release. Neither full weights nor results of external safety work were shown to be public at the cutoff.
summary.zhHans: Thinking Machines Lab 于 11 月 5 日宣布 Inkling 2 Small，并称用户可在 Tinker Playground 试用、在 Tinker 上微调或采样。公司计划在完成外部安全测试和红队评估后，于随后一周按 Apache 2.0 许可发布完整权重；检查点也要等到权重发布时才可下载。截至本轮截止时，没有证据表明完整权重或外部安全测试结果已公开。

narrative.en: This is hosted access to Inkling 2 Small, a distinct later model stage from the July original Inkling entry, not an open-weight launch of the new model. Internal demonstrations and benchmark charts belong to the developer; independent evaluation of generalized performance and adoption is not in this packet.
narrative.zhHans: 这次是 Inkling 2 Small 的托管访问，属于与 7 月原版 Inkling 条目不同的后续模型阶段，并非新模型的开放权重发布。内部演示与跑分图表出自开发方；本轮没有可支持泛化性能或采用规模的独立评估。

text.en: Thinking Machines said Inkling 2 Small was available in Tinker Playground and for sampling and fine-tuning on Tinker on November 5.
text.zhHans: Thinking Machines 称，Inkling 2 Small 于 11 月 5 日可在 Tinker Playground 使用，并可在 Tinker 上采样和微调。

text.en: The lab planned to release full weights and downloadable checkpoints after external testing, not on the hosted-launch date.
text.zhHans: 实验室计划在外部测试后发布完整权重及可下载的检查点，而不是在托管服务上线日同时开放。
